_note: Order is Parker's own ranking from parkermanley.com/films. featured: true puts a film in Now Showing. role empty means he wrote, directed, shot and edited it.

films.title: Scar Tissue
films.synopsis: A college student attempts at pursuing love while avoiding loss.

films.title: Abundance
films.synopsis: Seven individuals appear in a barren wasteland. Together, they construct a fence to keep themselves safe from nearby spikes, but soon their greed calls them to explore.

films.title: The Bend
films.synopsis: A man discovers himself in an abandoned stairwell and doesn't like what he sees.

films.title: Reflect
films.synopsis: Sammy is studying for the SAT and gets a visit from herself 20 years in the future, who encourages her that life will turn out good. But the older Samantha's life is not all that it seems.

films.title: As We Are, You Shall Be
films.synopsis: Death has come to visit Jeremey Bliemans, sweeping him away from his office job to delight him with a macabre dance.

films.title: Anthropocene

films.synopsis: Henry dreams of escaping into the comforting arms of Mother Nature like the transcendentalist adventurers of the past, but his true feelings are more complicated in an age where wilderness and civilization are inseparable.

films.title: Hot Tempered
films.synopsis: Two roommates vie over control of the thermostat in their dorm, going to extreme lengths to get what they want.

films.title: Ripped

films.title: Wonderland
films.synopsis: When times get tough, we can either accept reality and heal, or deny it and escape into our own wonderland.

films.title: Everybody (Backstreet's Back)
films.synopsis: A comedic music video to "Everybody (Backstreet's Back)" by the Backstreet Boys.

films.title: A Moment
films.synopsis: A murderer attempting to leave the scene of the crime is delayed by the daughter of the victim arriving to check up on her dad.

films.title: The Perfect Hill
films.synopsis: Emmett and Jeremy hunt day and night for the perfect hill for a special occasion.

films.title: The Runaround
films.synopsis: Two thieves attempt to heist an object from a house without knowing anything about the inhabitants nor the object itself.

films.title: Hooked on a Feeling
films.synopsis: A comedic music video to "Hooked on a Feeling" by Blue Swede.

films.title: Somnambulist
films.synopsis: A teenager spending a night in a hostel in Utah becomes trapped in his own dreams, guided through specific steps to make his way back home.

films.synopsis: Adam's flirtatious evening takes a chilling turn when an unsettling entity emerges from his bed, forcing him to confront the consequences of his secrets.
films.made_for: Accepted to the USC School of Cinematic Arts

films.title: The Teeth Deal
films.synopsis: Three brutes beat up the Tooth Fairy to get their teeth back.

films.title: The Best Worst Day of My Life
films.synopsis: A college student takes us through his memory of when he greatly let his roommate down. In the style of Wes Anderson.

films.synopsis: Neo is about to learn that choosing between the blue and red pills isn't as straightforward as he expected. Based on The Matrix.

films.title: Bye Bye Bye
films.synopsis: A comedic music video to "Bye Bye Bye" by *NSYNC, with choreography from Deadpool & Wolverine.

films.title: Wither & Bloom

films.title: Falling
films.synopsis: A distant teenager experiences a vision, swept through classic movies to understand the value of life.

films.synopsis: The Ancient Greek Pantheon has resurfaced in suburban Colorado, and a camera crew gets an exclusive day in the life of the Olympians.

films.role: Created with Aaliyah Roberson & Shepard Johnson

films.title: The Ultimate Trojan Game Show
films.synopsis: A game show I created and hosted, run through Trojan Vision at USC.

films.title: Acting Reel
films.synopsis: My acting from 2023 to 2024.
